content.title: Update release workflow and gitignore for docs overhaul
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

After library-developer removes TypeDoc and library-release writes new docs, update the project configuration:

1. Edit .github/workflows/release.yml: remove the TypeDoc generation step and GitHub Pages deployment step. These relied on TypeDoc which is now removed. Docusaurus deployment will be a separate future task.
2. Edit .gitignore: remove the docs-html/ entry (no longer relevant since we removed TypeDoc HTML output).

This is a CTO-owned task because these files are in CTO's access domain.

content.reason: Blocker issue mpdpu00ksc transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. Two configuration changes delivered:

1. **.github/workflows/release.yml**: Removed TypeDoc generation step (`bun run docs`), GitHub Pages artifact upload, and Pages deployment. Removed now-unnecessary permissions (`pages: write`, `id-token: write`), `environment: github-pages`, and the pages concurrency group. Workflow now cleanly runs quality → build → npm publish.

2. **.gitignore**: Replaced broad `docs/` entry with `docs/html/` only. This allows the new `docs/markdown/` hand-written docs to be tracked in git while still ignoring generated Docusaurus output (future).
